run_letter_classifier_training: run the letter classifier training on Libri-Light audio data with CTC loss over multiple epochs
eval_wer_on_dataset: evaluate word error rate on a dataset using multiprocessing workers and a WlDecoder
train_step_ctc_criterion: run a single training step with a CTC criterion, optimizer, and downsampling factor on a data loader
val_step_ctc_criterion: run a single validation step with a CTC criterion and downsampling factor on a data loader
prepare_data_for_cuda: prepare batched sequence and label data for CUDA processing with optional device placement
